content.scenario: A consumer, Leela, purchased a defective product and filed a complaint under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. She also wants to file a complaint under another law, such as the Indian Contract Act, 1872.
content.outcome: The provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, shall be in addition to and not in derogation of the provisions of any other law for the time being in force, including the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Therefore, Leela can file a complaint under both laws.

user_queries: Can a consumer file complaints under multiple laws?
Does the Consumer Protection Act override other laws?
What if another law provides more protection than the Consumer Protection Act?
